2026-11-06.homeNewsDetails: Luukkonen will start vs. Columbus on Friday.
2026-11-06.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Colten Ellis has been between the pipes for the past two games, but Luukkonen will return on Friday. With Alex Lyon (upper body) nearing his season debut, Luukkonen's inconsistent start to the 2026-27 season could put his future playing time in jeopardy. That said, the 27-year-old Finnish goalie is coming off one of his best outings of the season, saving 27 of 29 shots (.931 SV%) in a 3-2 win over the Los Angeles Kings. He has a 3.40 GAA and .874 SV% in 10 games (4-3-3). The Sabres enter Friday's game as -170 home favourites against a Columbus Blue Jackets team that defeated the Dallas Stars 2-1 in a shootout last night.
2026-11-06.awayNewsDetails: Greaves will start in Buffalo on Friday.
2026-11-06.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Greaves is coming off an impressive rookie season but has struggled to start the 2026-27 season, recently losing starts to Cam Talbot, who has been more consistent. The 25-year-old Greaves last played on October 31st, when he allowed two goals on 16 shots (.875 SV%) in a 3-1 loss to the Dallas Stars. He has a 3.11 GAA and an .883 SV% in eight appearances this season (2-5-0). The Blue Jackets enter Friday's game as +153 road underdogs against a Buffalo Sabres team coming off a 2-1 loss to the Ottawa Senators.

2026-11-06.homeNewsDetails: Wallstedt will start vs. San Jose on Friday.
2026-11-06.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Wallstedt has been busy with Filip Gustavsson (hip) sidelined and will return to the crease for the 16th time in Minnesota's first 18 games. The 23-year-old Swedish goalie has been outstanding to start the 2026-27 season, giving Head Coach John Hynes no reason to deviate, posting a stellar 2.06 GAA and .920 SV% in 15 games (10-2-3). In his last six games (4-1-1), Gustavsson has allowed two or fewer goals five times. Minnesota enters Friday's outing as a sizeable -273 home favourite against a struggling San Jose Sharks team that has scored only seven goals combined in their past five games (1-4-0).
2026-11-06.awayNewsDetails: Askarov will start in Minnesota on Friday.
2026-11-06.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Despite team struggles, Askarov had strung together several strong outings before his worst performance of the season in San Jose's most recent game, allowing seven goals on 26 shots (.731 SV%) in a 7-2 loss to the Los Angeles Kings. Still, the 24-year-old Russian goalie has a 2.69 GAA and .914 SV% in his last six games (2-4-0). The Sharks enter Friday's action as significant +234 road underdogs against the 11-3-3 Central Division-leading Minnesota Wild.

2026-11-06.homeNewsDetails: Wolf will start vs. Anaheim on Friday.
2026-11-06.homeNewsFantasyDetails: The Flames were leaning on Devin Cooley before his lower-body injury, but now, upon his return, they will roll with Wolf, who was solid in Cooley's absence. The 25-year-old Wolf saved 27 of 29 shots (.931 SV%) in his most recent outing, a 2-1 overtime loss to the Seattle Kraken. In his last three games (2-0-1), he has a stellar 1.69 GAA and .936 SV%. The Flames enter Friday's game as -140 home favourites against an Anaheim Ducks team that has been thriving offensively, scoring five or more goals in six straight games (4-1-1).
2026-11-06.awayNewsDetails: Dostal will start in Calgary on Friday.

2026-11-07.homeNewsDetails: Sorokin is expected to start vs. New Jersey on Saturday.
Pickard will start vs. Tampa Bay on Saturday.
2026-11-07.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Jesper Wallstedt has been the NHL's busiest goalie this season, and deservedly so, with consistently stellar play, but Minnesota will turn to Pickard on Saturday in the tail end of a back-to-back. The 34-year-old Pickard, signed in the offseason to back up Wallstedt while Filip Gustavsson (hip) is sidelined, has barely played in 2026-27. He has a 3.50 GAA and .833 SV% in two games (1-1-0) and has not played in two weeks.
